name: linkintel
description: Analyse your X posts and saved references to plan and draft what to write next.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence for your next X post
interface.longDescription: Plan your next X post from your recent results, saved reference posts and sourced ranking signals. Compare your strongest posts, prepare an evidence brief, and draft with citations in your assistant. Connect your LinkIntel account with access to X analytics, then connect X for personal performance analysis. New X connections may need to wait for the scheduled data sync. LinkIntel never publishes posts or guarantees reach.
defaultPrompt: What should I post on X this week based on my recent results?
Which of my X posts performed best, and what can I learn from them?
Use my saved references to help me draft an X post.
